subject: Learning Methods
title: Speed Reading Promises
description: A fast breakdown of Speed Reading Promises for builders.

hook.text: Speed reading courses promise 1,000 words per minute with full comprehension. Research says both claims are false.

buildup.text: Normal reading speed is 200 to 300 words per minute. Beyond 400, comprehension drops sharply for complex texts.

discovery.text: Speed reading techniques like skimming sacrifice understanding. You can skim faster but you are not truly reading.

twist.text: The fastest way to read more is not speed. It is eliminating what you do not need to read at all.

climax.text: Be selective about what you read. Then read it at normal pace with full attention. Selection beats speed.

punchline.text: Read less. Read it well. Selection trumps speed.

quiz.question: What happens to comprehension above 400 words per minute?
options: It stays the same for trained readers
It drops sharply for complex material
It improves because your brain works faster
